description: The beach warning flag lifeguards reported this morning at the nearest beaches (green, yellow, red, double red = water closed, purple = stinging marine life), with the report time, water temperature and notes: rip currents seen, surf height, jellyfish, stingrays, red tide coughing, dead fish. From Mote Marine Laboratory's Beach Conditions Reporting System, about twice a day at 131 beaches (Sarasota, Lee, Collier, Pinellas, Manatee, Charlotte, the Keys, Pensacola, some Atlantic beaches, Alabama, Texas, the Carolinas, Georgia). Give a position or a beach/town name. Gives one sentence to say out loud and what each flag means, plus how to volunteer as a Mote Beach Ambassador (Florida Panhandle first). Never says the water is safe.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

place.description: Or a beach or town name, e.g. Siesta Key, Lido, Naples Pier, Pensacola Beach
